channel.title: Livable Telluride — Family & Kids
channel.description: Upcoming storytime, youth programs, and all-ages activities across the Telluride region.

item.title: [Thu, Jun 11] Storytime / Hora de Cuentos
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Lower Terrace - outdoors 10:30 AM – 11:30 AM · English stories, songs, rhymes and fun for children of all ages and their parents or caregivers. Cuentos, canciones, rimas y diversión en inglés para niños de todas las edades y sus padres o cuidadores.

item.title: [Thu, Jun 11] Learn to Play Pickleball with your family • Aprende a jugar al pickleball con tu familia!
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Telluride Town Park 11:30 AM – 1:00 PM · Our favorite summer series is back, and this time with a twist! Kristen Milord will be teaching families how to play pickleball at the town courts (thank you, Parks and Recreation). We will offer one class each month for instruction and practice. Space is limited. Please sign up each family member separately and in advance. Join us for some fun and fitness this summer! • ¡Nuestra serie de verano favorita está de regreso, y esta vez con una novedad! Kristen Milord enseñará a las familias a jugar pickleball en las canchas municipales (gracias al Departamento de Parques y Recreación). Ofreceremos una clase cada mes para instrucción y práctica. El cupo es limitado. Por favor, inscríbase con antelación. ¡Acompáñenos para disfrutar de diversión y actividad física este verano!

item.title: [Thu, Jun 11] Gardening Camp / Campamento de Jardinería
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Wilkinson Public Library 12:30 PM – 3:30 PM · Join us for four fun-filled afternoons of hands-on gardening and learning. Projects and activities will include: planting a garden, garden decor crafts, earthworm play, storytimes, fairy and gnome play, and more! Who: Open to children ages 6-12 who can participate independently (without a parent or caregiver present). Registration : Space is limited- please only register if your child can attend all four days. Final Day: Celebrate with a public "ribbon cutting" garden reveal during the last hour of camp- friends and family welcome! What to Bring: A full belly Water bottle Sunhat & sunscreen Extra snacks Some snacks will be provided. All other items are the caregiver's responsibility. We can't wait to get garden with you! ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ¡Únanse a nosotros para cuarto tardes llenas de diversion con jardinería y aprendizaje! …

item.title: [Thu, Jun 11] Littles On the Move
item.description: 🎫 Wilkinson Public Library 📍 Program Room 3:30 PM – 4:30 PM · Join us at this inclusive and welcoming playgroup for children ages 0-3 and their grownups. We have tunnels, a ball pit, instruments, and sensory activities. Únase a nosotros en este grupo de juego inclusivo y acogedor para niños de 0 a 3 años y sus adultos. Habrá túneles, piscina de bolas, instrumentos y actividades sensoriales.
